description: Implementation of (2^1+,2) cuckoo hashing in jemalloc, including functions for search, insert, remove, grow, shrink, and rebuild operations, with specific focus on internal hash table management.

methods.name: ckh_bucket_search
methods.description: Search a specific bucket for a key, return cell index if found.

methods.name: ckh_isearch
methods.description: Search the hash table for a key, return cell index if found.

methods.name: ckh_try_bucket_insert
methods.description: Attempt to insert a key/data pair into a specified bucket.

methods.name: ckh_evict_reloc_insert
methods.description: Evict and relocate items to find space for new insertion, detect cycles.

methods.name: ckh_try_insert
methods.description: Attempt to insert a key/data pair, with eviction if necessary.

methods.name: ckh_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuild hash table from existing entries.

methods.name: ckh_grow
methods.description: Increase hash table size and rebuild.

methods.name: ckh_shrink
methods.description: Reduce hash table size and rebuild.

methods.name: ckh_new
methods.description: Initialize a new cuckoo hash table with minimum items.

methods.name: ckh_delete
methods.description: Delete and free hash table resources.

methods.name: ckh_count
methods.description: Return the number of items in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_insert
methods.description: Insert a key/data pair into the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_remove
methods.description: Remove a key/data pair from the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_search
methods.description: Search for a key in the hash table.
